name: ROBROS IGRIS-C
summary: A 154 cm, 56 kg bipedal humanoid from Seoul with 7-DOF arms and 6-DOF hands, sold with a teleoperation master arm for data collection; it is in paid industrial trials in South Korea.

germany.statusNote: ROBROS lists availability as South Korea and says global inquiries are welcome. No German or EU distributor or price was found.

specs.label: DOF per hand
specs.conditions: two hands; H5_C five-finger hand, other end effectors offered

specs.label: DOF per leg
specs.conditions: plus 3 DOF waist and 2 DOF neck

specs.label: OS / middleware / API
specs.value: Linux, Cyclone DDS, C++ and Python APIs
specs.quote: Linux / Cyclone DDS / C++ & Python APIs

specs.label: Perception
specs.value: RGB stereo and depth camera, 6-axis IMU

specs.label: Robots sold (cumulative, company figure)
specs.conditions: 36 units produced; as reported in September 2026
specs.quote: The Seoul startup reports 18 cumulative robot sales and 36 units produced

capabilities.sdk: Linux / Cyclone DDS / C++ & Python APIs
notes: Stairs and slopes are a maker claim; the robot is marketed for indoor collaboration.
Ships with a master arm for teleoperation and imitation-learning data, a remote control app and a data platform.
ROBROS offers several end effectors (H5_C five-finger hand and two grippers); which one ships as standard is not stated.
Full-body teleoperation was demonstrated in September 2026; autonomous performance is not published.

researchEvidence.quote: Navigates complex terrains like slopes and stairs with ease.
